+def _replace_stderr_clixml(stderr: bytes) -> bytes:
+    """Replace complete CLIXML elements in stderr, retaining all other bytes."""
+    output = bytearray()
+    position = 0
+    search_position = 0
+    replaced = False
+
+    while header := _CLIXML_HEADER.search(stderr, search_position):
+        start = header.start()
+        xml_start = header.end()
+
+        # PowerShell can repeat the header before the first XML element.
+        while True:
+            next_header = _CLIXML_HEADER.match(stderr, xml_start)
+            if next_header is None:
+                break
+            xml_start = next_header.end()
+
+        xml_start = len(stderr) - len(stderr[xml_start:].lstrip(b"\r\n\t "))
+        if not stderr.startswith(b"<Objs ", xml_start):
+            search_position = header.end()
+            continue
+
+        end = stderr.find(b"</Objs>", xml_start)
+        if end == -1:
+            search_position = header.end()
+            continue
+        end += len(b"</Objs>")
+
+        # A single header can precede several adjacent Objs elements.
+        while True:
+            next_start = len(stderr) - len(stderr[end:].lstrip(b"\r\n\t "))
+            if not stderr.startswith(b"<Objs ", next_start):
+                break
+            next_end = stderr.find(b"</Objs>", next_start)
+            if next_end == -1:
+                break
+            end = next_end + len(b"</Objs>")
+
+        block = stderr[start:end]
+        try:
+            try:
+                text = block.decode("utf-8")
+            except UnicodeDecodeError:
+                text = block.decode("cp437")
+            decoded = _parse_clixml(text.encode("utf-8"))
+        except (ValueError, UnicodeError, ET.ParseError):
+            search_position = header.end()
+            continue
+
+        output.extend(stderr[position:start])
+        output.extend(decoded)
+        position = end
+        search_position = end
+        replaced = True
+
+    if not replaced:
+        return stderr
+    output.extend(stderr[position:])
+    return bytes(output)
+
